project.title: Microbial community composition of practical-scale DHS reactor in India
project.description: The characteristics of the microbial community composition of a practical-scale down-flow hanging sponge (DHS) reactor treating with high organic matter an d sulfate ion concentrations and its difference between seasons were investiga ted.
project.center_name: Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Ube College
